intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Ah s*** bruh, How did that happen???

intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Holy s***! I can breathe in this planet?? And why it's looks exactly like Earth but pixelated!?

intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Whatever, at least I'm still alive.

intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Better fix this ship and find her.

intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Let's see… I need a fuel huh?

intro_wake.speaker: player
intro_wake.text: Oh, a village? That’s surprising. I guess there must be some villager. Let's see what'd they look like.

intro_gun.speaker: player
intro_gun.text: Oh, A gun? Why it’s not pixelated? Whatever.

npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: Oh, you're finally here, young one.

npc_elder_01.speaker: player
npc_elder_01.text: Hello. I'm looking for a way out of this forest.

npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: That path is dangerous. Prepare yourself first.

npc_elder_01.speaker: npc
npc_elder_01.text: Here, take a look at what I have. It isn't free, mind you.

npc_5.speaker: npc
npc_5.text: Yo bro, be careful up there. That's the graveyard.

npc_5.speaker: npc
npc_5.text: No bro, you don't understand. Even if you kill all of them, they seem to be there still when you come back!

npc_6.speaker: npc
npc_6.text: Ah... The water looks so nice.

npc_7.speaker: npc
npc_7.text: You're the one with the 24 gun, right? Let me tell you a secret.

npc_7.speaker: npc
npc_7.text: When you're stuck, look for a times first. 3 times 8, 4 times 6, 2 times 12. The answer is usually hiding in there.

npc_7.speaker: npc
npc_7.text: And if the numbers are really bad, just use a skip ticket. Nobody's judging you.

npc_7.speaker: player
npc_7.text: You sound like you've been through a lot.

npc_7.speaker: npc
npc_7.text: I failed my 24 exam six times. They don't let me hold a gun anymore.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: *waves*

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: What is with this weirdo? Who are you? Why you look so roundy?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: And how’d you look like Among us? Are you John Among us??

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: You can speak English?????

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Of course, I can! We all do!

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: You even know the language’s called English!?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Are you joking? Of course, I do!

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: But how??

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Maybe The scriptwriter only know 1 or 2 language, and he chose for us to speak English??? Who knows?

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Fair enough.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Okay, as you may noticed. I’m not from this planet. My ship crashed not so far from here. I want to get back to where I came from. So do you guys have like… fuel?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Ah yes, we do. But you have to do some favor for us.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Yeah? What is it?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: I want you to get rid of the monster for us. They have been causing us trouble for so long now.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Huh? Me?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Yeah, You. I see you have a gun. That’s the 24 gun.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: I only see one?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: It’s just a name. You have to solve math 24 to shoot that gun!

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: That’s.. complicated.

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: You’re new here. This is a planet where math 24 determines everything.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Okay, It’s kinda making sense now.

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Yeah, I want you to kill 5 slimes under that big tree. Come back to me and I’ll give you some fuel.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Aight bet.

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Oh! um, Did you see someone that wear something like I am around here?

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Um… No?

npc_10.speaker: player
npc_10.text: Okay. Please let me know if you see her.

npc_10.speaker: npc
npc_10.text: Yeah, sure.

npc_10_waiting.speaker: npc
npc_10_waiting.text: The slimes are still under the big tree. Come back when all 5 are gone.

npc_10_complete.speaker: player
npc_10_complete.text: You expected me to fail or something?

npc_10_complete.speaker: npc
npc_10_complete.text: Of course not! Here’s your fuel.

npc_10_complete.speaker: npc
npc_10_complete.text: That must be him. John Among us, defeat that guy.

npc_10_complete.speaker: player
npc_10_complete.text: What guy? Some dude make that explosive sound!? How am I supposed to beat that guy??

npc_10_complete.speaker: npc
npc_10_complete.text: If you’re not confident with your strength right now. There’s a shop that sells artifacts which make you stronger not so far from here.

npc_10_complete.speaker: player
npc_10_complete.text: What? How can that make me stronger?

npc_10_complete.speaker: npc
npc_10_complete.text: Just go check it out. There’s description under items.

npc_10_boss_waiting.speaker: npc
npc_10_boss_waiting.text: That guy is still out there, in front of the cave.

npc_10_boss_waiting.speaker: npc
npc_10_boss_waiting.text: If you're not strong enough yet, check out the shop by the well.

npc_10_after.speaker: npc
npc_10_after.text: Go check your ship, SON. Maybe that's your friend.

npc_12.speaker: npc
npc_12.text: Who are you?? What are you doing here???

npc_12.speaker: npc
npc_12.text: Get out of here now. This is my place

npc_12.speaker: npc
npc_12.text: Ain't nobody gettin in to my place.

npc_12.speaker: player
npc_12.text: What are you hidding in there?

npc_12.speaker: npc
npc_12.text: NONE OF YOUR GOD D*** BUSINESS. NOW GET THE F*** OUT

npc_10_forest_done.speaker: npc
npc_10_forest_done.text: Ohhhh, you got it again!. Actually, I have one more quest for you.

npc_10_forest_done.speaker: npc
npc_10_forest_done.text: There’s monster in the cave that have been around for so long. And it hurts a lot of our people. Its mysterious energy makes it so powerful that we’re on par with it at all.

npc_10_forest_done.speaker: player
npc_10_forest_done.text: And you think I can beat it?

npc_10_forest_done.speaker: player
npc_10_forest_done.text: Okay?, I'll kick its a**. with an exchange for some fuel too, please?

npc_10_forest_done.speaker: npc
npc_10_forest_done.text: Of course, I’ll give you more fuel.

npc_10_cave_waiting.speaker: npc
npc_10_cave_waiting.text: The monster is still in the cave. Be careful, John Among us.

npc_10_cave_done.speaker: npc
npc_10_cave_done.text: Whoa, You actually beat it! Here’s your fuel!

npc_10_cave_done.speaker: player
npc_10_cave_done.text: That should be enough fuel. I’m going to fix the ship and get back home now.

npc_10_cave_done.speaker: npc
npc_10_cave_done.text: Oh I’ve seen someone lurking around your ship. maybe that’s your friend?

npc_10_cave_done.speaker: player
npc_10_cave_done.text: Really? I’ll go take a look!

boss_forest_intro.speaker: npc
boss_forest_intro.text: Who are you? what the F*** did you do to my slime? You're gonna pay for what you've done!

boss_forest_intro.speaker: player
boss_forest_intro.text: Yeah bro, pack it up. You're not that tuff. Eat my sh**.

boss_forest_outro.speaker: player
boss_forest_outro.text: It’s that easy. I’m kinda good at this though.

boss_cave_intro.speaker: player
boss_cave_intro.text: So it’s you, Nopnapha! No, That’s not right. It’s you that people are afraid of huh!

boss_cave_intro.speaker: player
boss_cave_intro.text: I shouldn’t have expect it to talk, should I? It didn’t even have a mouth. Whatever, Prepare to DIE!

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: Where the f*** have you been??

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: I'm about to fix the ship. Now, would you help me out?

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: Why would you want to fix the ship?

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: What? What do you mean? Of course, To get back to Earth??

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: Why would you want to leave this planet?

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: You must be very confused right now.

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: What are you!? Omg you’re blocky??

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: I'm the leader of all that monster.

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: Yes, I did. I want you to live here with me.

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: With that face of yours? Hell No! and what's with that 67 on your head?? Are you Brainrot type sh** or something???

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: Whatever, you are going to live here on this planet with me forever and ever.

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: WT*???? And with that you decided to bring me here???

jenny_meet.speaker: npc
jenny_meet.text: If you want to leave this planet, Then you'll have to get pass me.

jenny_meet.speaker: player
jenny_meet.text: I had a feeling you'd say that...

jenny_again.speaker: npc
jenny_again.text: You're not leaving this planet, John.

jenny_outro.speaker: player
jenny_outro.text: You look even uglier after you transformed, B****.

ship_fix.speaker: player
ship_fix.text: That's all three fuel pieces. Let's fix the ship!
